source_derived_alias_geometry.source_of_definitions: The actual per-case PROBE.LNK DEFINE statements were re-read and rehashed; they are only present in the plus-two contrast.

initial_count_state.limitation: This establishes original initial zero only; it does not validate runtime-loaded saved values.

write_order: signed-word count compare rejects values >= 6 in reachable states
BalloonIsVisible has a compiler stack-check helper call, then only comparisons and a return; no application callback is invoked
write message far pointer, Pnt pair, style word, plane word at count
producer_and_guard.invariant: Starting at zero, each completed AddMsgBalloon changes n to n+1 only for 0<=n<6; once n=6 every later call returns before any queue-array write.

consumer_boundary_and_reset.consumer: DrawBalloons at root:0250:4C34 iterates exactly while i<count and resets count to zero on its sole ordinary far return.

boundary_reset.semantics: resets count to zero before its sole far return
boundary_reset.not_claimed_from: the DrawBalloons scaffold body in src/root/m0250.c

consumer_boundary_and_reset.source_effective_order: f_0250_13A6 calls PreDrawBalloons and then optionally DrawSpider before DrawBalloons; PreDrawBalloons calls DrawCurBalloons. Thus the enumerated producers finish before the consumer reset boundary.

callbacks.qualification: The runtime stack-check helper in AddMsgBalloon/BalloonIsVisible is distinct from these game callback pointers; the disassembly identifies it as __aFchkstk. BalloonIsVisible has no indirect/application call after that prologue helper.

source_access_closure_and_SaveRec.count_mutation_interpretation: Across the 156-source lexical census the only statement forms are the AddMsgBalloon increment and DrawBalloons reset; repeated full-module behavior snapshots and the canonical DrawBalloons scaffold account for duplicate source locations.
source_access_closure_and_SaveRec.limitation: The census covers all 127 canonical TUs and 29 strict effective source modules. It is a source closure argument, not a claim that arbitrary corrupted runtime state is bounded.

logical_extent_reason_and_limits.reason: The producer's pre-write count guard makes the only attainable populated states 0..6; the consumer resets at each ordinary draw boundary, while startup begins at zero. Every parallel table write uses the same guarded index and each entry has the compiler-visible type/width independently checked by paired-linker fixtures.
